Definition
[Normal boundary condition] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0287 1. ch34:34.12\group Harmonic Maps with Boundary

A harmonic map $F:(M,g)\to (N,h)$ satisfies the normal boundary condition if $F(\partial M)\subset \partial N$ and $F_*(N_g)$ is normal to $\partial N$ with respect to $h$.
